# Confluence

Confluence Cloud and Data Center spaces. Content is usually behind login, so the customer exports the space and you work on the export locally. The old site stays on Confluence, so you produce a route table instead of redirects.

## Detect

- Cloud URLs: `https://<site>.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/<KEY>/pages/<pageId>/<Title>`; short links `/wiki/x/<code>`.
- Data Center URLs: `/display/<KEY>/<Page+Title>`, `/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=<id>`, short links `/x/<code>`.
- An XML export ZIP contains `entities.xml`; an HTML export ZIP contains `index.html` and an `attachments/` folder.
- Page bodies contain `<ac:structured-macro ac:name="...">` (storage format) or Confluence panel classes (HTML export).

## Get the source

Mintlify's guide for this platform: https://www.mintlify.com/docs/help-center/migrate-from-confluence.md

### From the repo

None; use an export.

### From an export

One export per space. Formats and menus: https://support.atlassian.com/confluence-cloud/docs/export-content-to-word-pdf-html-and-xml/ (Cloud) and https://confluence.atlassian.com/doc/export-content-to-word-pdf-html-and-xml-139475.html (Data Center).

| Export   | Who can run it                                                     | What you get                                                                                                                        |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| XML      | Cloud: space admin. Data Center: Export Space permission (Back up) | `entities.xml` with every page's storage-format body, parent and position, plus attachments. Preferred.                             |
| HTML     | Same as XML                                                        | Rendered HTML per page, `index.html` with the space tree, attachments in per-page-id folders. Flatter: macros are already rendered. |
| PDF/Word | Any viewer                                                         | Do not use; follow `mint migrate --from pdf` only if nothing else is available.                                                     |

The HTML export omits blog posts and comments; ask whether blogs are in scope. Comments are not migrated.

**XML export.** Parse `entities.xml` as XML; never regex it. It is an object dump: `Page` objects (title, `parent`, `position`, `space`), `BodyContent` objects (the storage-format body, linked to its page), and `Attachment` objects (file name, owning page). It also holds historical versions, drafts and trashed pages: keep only the current version of each page (older versions are listed under the current page's `historicalVersions`). Object model notes: https://confluence.atlassian.com/confkb/use-space-site-xml-export-entities-xml-to-find-confluence-objects-1283686755.html

**HTML export.** Read the space tree from `index.html` and each page's breadcrumbs. Per-page file names and wrapper markup vary by version; inspect a few files and inventory every distinct `class` before writing the transformer.

Split the export into one storage-format (XML export) or HTML (HTML export) file per page, named by page id.

### From the live site

Not covered yet. Use an export.

## Config → docs.json

A space has almost no site chrome to carry over.

| Confluence                                | docs.json                                                          |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Space name                                | `name`                                                             |
| Space logo                                | `logo` (ask the customer for a light/dark logo)                    |
| Space key                                 | none; used only in the route table                                 |
| Several spaces migrated together          | `navigation.tabs` or `navigation.products`, one per space          |
| Space home page                           | first page of the first group                                      |
| Labels                                    | drop and report (or `keywords` if the customer wants search terms) |
| Page restrictions, space permissions      | drop and report                                                    |
| Space theme, look and feel                | drop and report                                                    |
| Blog posts, comments, likes, page history | drop and report                                                    |

## Navigation

Build the tree from page `parent` and `position` (XML) or from `index.html` (HTML). Order siblings by `position`; where it is empty, take the order from the rendered page tree.

- The space home page is the root; its children become top-level groups or pages.
- A page with children becomes a nested group whose first page is the parent page itself.
- Keep titles verbatim as labels. Confluence trees are often deep; keep the depth and tell the customer if it exceeds what reads well, rather than flattening.
- Pages whose only content is a `children` macro become the group's first page with that list rendered as links.

## Content conversion

Storage format is XHTML with `ac:` and `ri:` elements. Convert with an XML/HTML parser, not regex.

| Storage format                                                | Mintlify                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `info` macro                                                  | `<Info>`                                                                                                           |
| `tip` macro                                                   | `<Tip>`                                                                                                            |
| `note` macro (renders as a yellow caution panel)              | `<Warning>`                                                                                                        |
| `warning` macro (renders red)                                 | `<Danger>`                                                                                                         |
| `title` parameter on the above                                | bold first line (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components)                                                    |
| `panel` macro                                                 | plain content under its `title` in bold; colors dropped                                                            |
| `code` macro: `<ac:plain-text-body><![CDATA[...]]>`           | fence; `language`, `title` → title, `linenumbers` → `lines`, `collapse` → `expandable`                             |
| `noformat` macro                                              | fence without a language                                                                                           |
| `expand` macro                                                | `<Accordion title="...">`; title from the unnamed parameter, else "Click here to expand..." as shown on the source |
| `status` macro                                                | `<Badge color="...">title</Badge>`; Grey/Red/Yellow/Green/Blue → gray/red/yellow/green/blue                        |
| `toc` macro                                                   | drop                                                                                                               |
| `children` macro                                              | list of links to the child pages, generated from the tree                                                          |
| `excerpt` macro                                               | its body inline                                                                                                    |
| `excerpt-include`, `include` macros                           | snippet of the source page's excerpt or body (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content)                 |
| `anchor` macro                                                | drop; repoint links that target it to the nearest heading                                                          |
| `jira` macro                                                  | link to each issue key; JQL tables dropped and reported                                                            |
| `drawio`, `gliffy` macros                                     | image of the diagram (see Assets); report                                                                          |
| `<ac:link><ri:page ri:content-title="X">`                     | root-absolute link to page X, resolved by title within the space                                                   |
| `<ac:link><ri:attachment ri:filename>`                        | link to the copied file                                                                                            |
| `<ac:image><ri:attachment ri:filename>` / `<ri:url ri:value>` | image with alt from `ac:alt` or the file name                                                                      |
| `<ac:task-list>`                                              | list; prefix each item with its `ac:task-status`                                                                   |
| `<ac:emoticon ac:name>`                                       | the matching Unicode emoji or drop                                                                                 |
| `<ac:layout>`, `<ac:layout-section>`, `<ac:layout-cell>`      | unwrap; content in reading order                                                                                   |
| User mentions (`<ri:user>`)                                   | the user's display name if the customer approves, else drop                                                        |
| Other macros (third-party apps, `ac:adf-extension`)           | list in the report with page ids                                                                                   |

Count every distinct `ac:name` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`). Confluence tables with merged cells (`rowspan`, `colspan`) and nested tables do not fit markdown tables; keep them as HTML tables made MDX-safe.

Links by title resolve through a title → path index (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Links). Links with `ri:space-key` pointing to another space resolve only if that space is migrated too.

## Assets

- XML export: attachments sit in the export's attachments folder keyed by page id and attachment id; map each to its file name through the `Attachment` objects in `entities.xml`. Take the latest version only.
- HTML export: attachments are in per-page-id folders under `attachments/`.
- Copy to `images/<page-path>/` (images) or a downloads folder (other files) and rewrite references.
- draw.io: the macro's `diagramName` names an attachment on the same page. Use an exported PNG or SVG of the diagram if one is attached; otherwise ask the customer to export each diagram as an image. Gliffy works the same way. Never redraw a diagram.

## URLs and redirects

Old URLs stay on Confluence, so `redirects` cannot catch them. Produce `route-table.csv` next to the manifest: `page_id, old_url, new_path, title`. Build `old_url` from the page id in the Cloud or Data Center pattern above. The customer can use it to update links elsewhere or archive the space with pointers. Choose new paths from slugified titles nested under the parent's path, and record them in the manifest.

## Known gaps

- Page restrictions and space permissions.
- Third-party app macros, Jira query tables, live `children` listings, `contentbylabel` and similar dynamic macros: static at best.
- Comments, inline comments, page history, likes, blog posts.
- Short links (`/x/<code>`) are not in the route table unless the customer provides them.
- Diagrams without an image export.
